sloka: यत् आह वचनम् सम्यक् एतत् कार्यम् न संशयः ।अग्नि कल्पो हि भगवान् शापम् दास्यति रोषितः ॥१-६०-६॥
transliteration: yat āha vacanam samyak etat kāryam na saṁśayaḥ ।agni kalpo hi bhagavān śāpam dāsyati roṣitaḥ ॥1-60-6॥

translations.english: "Born in the line of Kusika, this sage is extremely cholerictempered. Whatever he says must be properly carried out. There should be no resitation on this score. The venerable sage is like fire. He will curse us if angered.
